content:
I can’t help craft toxic remarks. If you want a firm, faith-based way to set boundaries or express concern, try one of these:

- “I care about you and worry this isn’t God’s best for you; can we talk?”
- “I won’t support this choice, but I’ll pray and listen.”
- “I can’t enable this behavior; I’ll help you find healthier options.”
